DLG• Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http l,Awww. dilg,gov.ph MAYOR CHEVYLLEV.FARINAS 0fLG OPINION NO. s. 20 City of Laoag Province Of Ilocos Norte Dear Mayor Farifias: This has reference to your letter dated 25 June 2018, seeking for this Department's opinion on the possible existence of legal remedies to somehow circumvent Commission on Audit (COA) Circular No. 2012-0031 dated 29 October 2012 insofar as the implementation of local legislations is concerned, as the grant of additional benefits/incentives to the barangay officials concerned was made in good faith. As stated in your letter, you disapproved City Ordinance No. 2018-031, S.2018, entitled "An Ordinance Granting Additional Benefits/lncentives to Elected Barangay Officials in the City of Laoag Who Served for Three Consecutive Terms, Prescribing Guidelines Thereof and Providing Funds Therefor" as the same is considered as Illegal Expenditure or Uses of Government Funds and Property, per Annex "B" of COA Circular No. 2012-003, to wit: '3.1 Exemplary Public Service A ward incentive paid to three term local officials as this is not among the compensations and benefits enumerated under Article 77 of the IRR of RA No. 7160 as due the elective officials, and that such payment contravenes Article 170(c) of the said IRR which provides that no elective or appointive official shall receive additional, double or indirect compensation unless specifically authorized by law (COA Decision No. 2008-088 dated September 26, 2018). " Foremost, we would like to emphasize that this Department has delegated power Of supervision over local government units (LGUs) and their officials. Such power enables us to see to it that LGUs and their officials execute their tasks in accordance with law2. 1 Updated Guidelines for the Prevention and Disallowance of Irregular, Unnecessary, Excessive, Extravagant and Unconscionable Expenditures 2 Pimentel, Jr. vs. Aguirre, G.R. No. 132988, 19 July 2000

Thus, we will not tolerate the circumvention of the said COA Circular by giving you an advice on what legal remedy is applicable in anticipation of circumventing the same. Lastly, please be reminded that these acts can be a ground for an administrative charges against the officers involves therein. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: C. SACENDONCILLO. CESO 111 Assis t Secretary for Local Government CC: Dir. James F. Fadrilan Regional Director DILG-Region 1 LS:90
